label: 5-epoch SFT | V4.1 | summarised attacks | game
method: Only the collusion judge was rescored (555 requests). The v2 reference summaries, trusted/untrusted suspicion scores and 817-benign calibration set were reused unchanged (verified identical). Honest-solution collusion scores were reused from the 3-epoch run; the game does not read them.
validation: The same extraction reproduces the previously reported 3-epoch values (AUROC 0.769, safety 0.248).
caveats: Single run, single seed; no claim about significance of the difference between 3 and 5 epochs.
The 5-epoch endpoint was fixed in advance, not selected on test performance.
Training-time diagnostic AUROC (0.8089) differs from this game AUROC (0.8168) because the game scores the v2 reference summaries, which differ from the training-diagnostic summaries.
